title: PIA's first Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner arrives in Islamabad

article.title: PIA's first Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner arrives in Islamabad
article.summary: Pakistan International Airlines’ (PIA) first Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner, acquired on lease last month, arrived in Islamabad from London as flight PK786 on Sunday. A PIA spokesperson, in a statement, said that the carrier is the first Pakistani airline to have added a Boeing 787-9 to its fleet. PIA Chief Executive Aamir Hayat, accompanied by his team, welcomed the Dreamliner at Islamabad airport, according to the statement. The plane is equipped with modern technology, including in-flight entertainment, and features a spacious and comfortable cabin, PIA said. “The inclusion of the Dreamliner is part of a strategy to modernise PIA’s fleet and strengthen its international network,” the spokesperson said. Photo shows the inside of the Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner, which arrived in Islamabad on Sunday. — Photo courtesy PIA “PIA’s objective is to provide international-standard travel facilities and a more comfortable air travel experience to passengers through modern aircraft.” The Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner is a long-range, twin-engine plane with up to 325 seats.
